basic_details.short_information: EdCIL (India) Limited, a Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE under the Ministry of Education, on behalf of the Ministry of Education and Skills Development of the Royal Government of Bhutan (RGoB), invites online applications from Indian PGT teachers for 40 contract posts in higher secondary schools of Bhutan: 30 in Computer Science/ICT and 10 in Mathematics. The consolidated gross remuneration is Rs. 1,40,000 per month for a minimum tenure of two years. how_to_apply: Apply online through the EdCIL website https://edcilteacherrecruitment.com. No other mode of application is accepted.
Keep a valid personal email ID active throughout the recruitment. All details are shared through the registered email ID, and the ID should not be shared with any other person.
Write the name, date of birth and parents' names exactly as in the Class X certificates or mark sheets. Any change or alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
Fill in the online application form, and scan and upload the recent photograph and signature as the form instructs.
The login ID and password are sent by email on registration. Keep that mail until all steps are complete.
Submit the application by 11 December 2026. No modification is allowed after submission.

The notice advises candidates not to wait for the last date and time, and to register well before it. For problems with the online form, contact the EdCIL Help Desk on 0120-2970599 (10 AM to 5 PM, Monday to Friday only) or at [email protected]. Queries can also be checked in the FAQs section on the website.
Marksheets of Class X and XII, and final marksheets of Graduation, Post-graduation and B.Ed., as applicable.
Latest updated resume covering qualifications, skills and proficiencies (English and ICT tools); the committee uses it for shortlisting.
Any other qualification documents to be filled in the application.
Scanned recent photograph (not more than 1 month old, jpg/jpeg) and scanned signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg); each image minimum 20 kb and maximum 50 kb.

Work experience certificate with last pay drawn. If it is not available, a joining letter with the latest 3-month salary slip may be submitted. It must be on the employer's letterhead; handwritten certificates are not accepted as proof.
PAN Card and Passport / Voter-ID as ID proof. A passport must be valid till the end of the tenure.
important_instructions: EdCIL does not enter into correspondence about candidature, and no separate intimation is sent. Call letters and all announcements go to the registered email only. Downloading or printing the admit card or interview letter is the candidate's responsibility. Candidates should check the spam folder from time to time. EdCIL is not responsible for emails lost due to a wrong email ID. Admission at all stages is provisional. EdCIL may verify eligibility at any time before or after selection, and issue of a call letter does not mean candidature is finally cleared. If the online data differs from the original testimonials, the candidature is liable to be rejected. Incomplete applications are rejected. Original documents must be produced at the interview. A missing document may lead to cancellation of the candidature. A request for change of interview date or venue will not be entertained under any circumstances. A candidate can be disqualified and debarred, permanently or for a specified period, for impersonation, irregular means, obtaining support for candidature, or false, tampered or fabricated particulars. Terms of appointment, employment, termination and renewal follow the applicable laws of the Royal Government of Bhutan. Disputes are subject to the courts having jurisdiction in Delhi only.

rows.details: EdCIL (India) Limited, on behalf of the Royal Government of Bhutan
PGT Teacher – Computer Science/ICT; PGT Teacher – Mathematics
Rs. 1,40,000/- per month, consolidated gross remuneration

content_sections.heading: About EdCIL
content_sections.text: EdCIL (India) Limited is a Mini Ratna Category-1 CPSE under the Ministry of Education, located at EdCIL House, 18-A, Sector 16-A, NOIDA 201301 (UP). This notice is titled "Recruitment of STEM Teachers for the Royal Government of Bhutan – Phase IV". The teachers are engaged for the Bhutan Government's higher secondary schools, and the decision on shortlisting and final selection rests with the Royal Government of Bhutan.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 40 vacancies in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals can apply. Both posts are for PGT teachers, and the qualification is the same for both except for the B.Ed. rule. Proficiency in teaching in the English Language. 5 years' work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grade 7 to 12. Teaching experience in universities or institutions beyond grade 12 is also considered, provided the candidate has prior teaching experience in schools. High proficiency in use of technology for education in Computer Science/ICT. Experience in providing instructional leadership in technology is listed (evidence of using emerging ed-tech, advanced ICT tools for teaching, ICT trainings or professional development programmes conducted). Proficiency in teaching in the English Language. 5 years' work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grade 7 to 12. Teaching experience in universities or institutions beyond grade 12 is also considered, provided the candidate has prior teaching experience in schools. High proficiency in use of technology for education in Mathematics (evidence of initiatives in using ICT in teaching mathematics). Age: maximum 55 years as on 25 November 2026. The cut-off date for educational qualification, age limit, experience and other eligibility criteria is 25 November 2026. No age or category relaxation is given. Good physical fitness and no medical condition that may hinder service during the contract term; a medical certificate is to be submitted at the time of joining. Candidates must be prepared to teach classes 7 to 12. Candidates working in Government organizations must submit an NOC/Vigilance/Service certificate at document verification or interview, if shortlisted. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marks
rows.desirable: B.Ed. from a recognized university is preferable (not mandatory)

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marks; B.Ed. from a recognized university is mandatory

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Teachers are paid a consolidated gross remuneration of Rs. 1,40,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Forty Thousand only) per month from the date of joining. Local tax as per the "Income Tax Act and Health" contribution of 1% applies on the gross remuneration. The tenure is a minimum of two years. It may be renewed based on performance and subject requirements. Teachers may be posted and relocated anywhere in Bhutan depending on the requirement of the RGoB. The RGoB provides all necessary assistance for the work permit as applicable. Leave, medical benefits, travel passage and other terms of employment are as per the contract with the RGoB. Selected candidates get air tickets for to-and-fro travel on the India–Bhutan sector at the start and end of the tenure only. Travel of dependents, spouses or family members is arranged by the candidate. If a candidate returns to India before completing the tenure, the cost of travel is borne by the candidate. Travel for vacation or personal visits to India during the tenure is also at the candidate's cost.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A panel of officials from India and the Royal Government of Bhutan shortlists eligible candidates for interview. Meeting the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to an interview. EdCIL/RGoB reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after preliminary screening and short-listing by qualifications, suitability and experience. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the venue, date and schedule on their registered email IDs only. The physical interview is held in New Delhi only. Document verification takes place at the interview. Candidates bring the application printout with photograph affixed and original self-attested copies of certificates for age, qualification, work experience and others as applicable. Any change of name needs valid government-issued proof at document verification on the day of the interview. Selected candidates undergo mandatory medical screening including a drug test on arrival in Bhutan. Those who pass both sign the employment contract; those who fail return to India. The RGoB decides the recruitment process, including shortlisting and final selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in EdCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 vacancies: 30 for Computer Science/ICT and 10 for Mathematics PGT teachers in Bhutan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the EdCIL Bhutan teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 11 December 2026. Registration began on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for EdCIL PGT teacher posts?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marks. B.Ed. is mandatory for Mathematics and preferable (not mandatory) for Computer Science/ICT.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need 5 years' work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grade 7 to 12. University or higher institution experience counts only if the candidate also has prior school teaching experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years as on 25 November 2026. The notice gives no age or category relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for EdCIL Bhutan teachers?
faq.answer: A consolidated gross remuneration of Rs. 1,40,000 per month from the date of joining. Local tax as per the "Income Tax Act and Health" contribution of 1% applies on the gross remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only through https://edcilteacherrecruitment.com. No other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A panel of officials from India and the Royal Government of Bhutan shortlists candidates for a physical interview in New Delhi. Final selection rests with the RGoB.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract basis for a minimum of two years, which may be renewed based on performance and subject requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Who pays for travel to Bhutan?
faq.answer: Air tickets on the India–Bhutan sector are provided at the start and end of the tenure only. Travel of family members and personal visits to India are at the candidate's own cost.
